question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.

The officer was not aware of the __sedulous__ espionage.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Diligent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word **'sedulous'** refers to being persistent, diligent, or tireless in an effort or activity. (परिश्रमी)

 
 
• **Example:** Her sedulous efforts to master the language were eventually successful.
 
 
 
• The synonym **'Diligent'** implies careful and persistent work or effort. (मेहनती)
 
 
• **Example: **He was a diligent worker, always the first to arrive and the last to leave.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Diligent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Dangerous'** means able or likely to cause harm or injury. (खतरनाक)
 
• **'Sedate' **refers to calm, dignified, and unhurried. (शांत)
 
• **'Seduce' **implies to attract (someone) to a belief or into a course of action that is inadvisable or foolhardy. (बहकाना)
